author: coder-sonnet
message: FIX-004 code change complete in tools/roadmap-dashboard/index.html: added module-level const userSelections = new Map() (ticketId -> {runner, model}) near the other module-level state (REFRESH_MS/ticketsCache/allowlists). In buildCard(), before building the select options I read userSelections.get(ticket.id) into `saved`; after building runnerSelect's options I set runnerSelect.value = saved.runner if that value exists among the options; refreshModelOptions() (already responsible for rebuilding modelSelect when runner changes) now also restores modelSelect.value = saved.model if that value exists among the newly-built options (handles both the claude-model-list case and the disabled codex n/a case, since saved.model would be '' for codex and that option value is '' too). Added saveSelection() which writes {runner: runnerSelect.value, model: modelSelect.value} into the map, wired to modelSelect's 'change' event and combined into runnerSelect's existing 'change' listener (which still calls refreshModelOptions() first, then saveSelection()). No changes to REFRESH_MS, the poll mechanism, server.mjs, FIX-001's disabled-attribute logic, or FIX-003's isHumanTask badge branch (map lookup only happens inside the existing else-branch for non-human tickets). Manually re-read the full buildCard()/render() region after editing to confirm brace/paren balance and that the human-task branch is untouched. BLOCKED on verification only: this sandbox's Bash tool requires per-command human approval for every invocation attempted (`node --check tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs`, a Function()-based inline-script syntax check via node -e, and `curl` against the running dashboard at 127.0.0.1:4570 were all rejected with 'This command requires approval/This Bash command contains multiple operations' even as single simple commands with no shell interpolation) -- consistent with FIX-002's documented note that acceptEdits gates Bash separately from Write/Edit. The ticket's verification commands (reload dashboard in a browser, select runner=codex, wait >4s across a poll cycle, confirm selection survives, repeat for a non-default claude model, confirm /api/execute sends the real selection) require an interactive browser session and a live server plus real wall-clock waiting across poll cycles -- none of which this headless, approval-gated executor can perform. Needs: a human (or an executor session with Bash/network approval granted) to (1) confirm the dashboard server is running on :4570 (restart via `node tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs` if not), (2) open it in a browser, select codex as runner on an eligible pending ticket, wait through at least one 4s poll tick, and confirm the dropdown still reads codex with model-select still showing the disabled 'n/a (codex adapter)' option; (3) repeat selecting a non-default claude model (e.g. claude-opus-4-8) and confirm it survives a poll tick; (4) click Ejecutar after a poll cycle and check the resulting /api/execute request body or ledger entry's runner/model fields match the actual selection, not a reset default. Code is believed correct by manual inspection but has zero automated or live-browser verification evidence attached to this entry.
